claims.text: Section 7.2 says either party may terminate, but only on the grounds listed after it. It does not give a general right to terminate without cause.

citations.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement without penalty and without prejudice to any claims arising prior to termination as follows:

claims.text: The only listed ground that does not depend on the other party's fault is termination by written agreement of both parties.

citations.quote: (a) Upon the written agreement of both parties.

claims.text: Either party may terminate for the other party's uncured breach, after written notice and a cure period.

citations.quote: (b) Upon the other party's breach of this Agreement provided          the terminating party has given written notice of the breach to the          other party specifying the breach, the action necessary to cure the          breach and the breaching party has not cured the breach within five          business days after notice is given

claims.text: Section 6.2 lets either party terminate on prior written notice if NPC does not request Compliance Modifications or the parties cannot agree on their terms. This is tied to a regulatory or compliance trigger, not a general convenience right.

citations.quote: If NPC does not request any Compliance Modifications or the parties cannot agree upon the terms of any Compliance Modifications, then either party may terminate this Agreement upon prior written notice to the other party

claims.text: Section 7.1 provides for automatic renewal unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least six months before renewal. This ends the agreement at the end of a term rather than providing early termination for convenience.

citations.quote: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless one party gives the other party written notice of non-renewal at least six months prior to automatic renewal.

claims.text: The other termination rights are one-sided and event-specific. NCB may terminate on NPC's bankruptcy filing, and NPC may terminate if NCB's bankcard association agreements or membership are terminated or materially limited.

citations.quote: By NCB immediately upon NPC's voluntary filing of any          petition or complaint seeking relief under any federal or state          bankruptcy or other debt relief statute

(d) By NPC immediately in the event that any agreements          between NCB and Visa and/or MasterCard or NCB's membership in either          such bankcard association shall be terminated or materially limited
